name: ImperialHal
noteEs: Pro player de TSM, considerado uno de los IGLs (in-game leaders) más influyentes en la historia competitive de Apex. Múltiples campeonatos ALGS, gameplay con team-coordination que define el meta competitivo. Sus streams en Twitch son view obligatoria para players serios sobre competitive — entendés how a top IGL piensa during high-pressure scrims y matches.
noteEn: TSM pro player, considered one of the most influential IGLs (in-game leaders) in Apex's competitive history. Multiple ALGS championships, team-coordinated gameplay defining the competitive meta. His Twitch streams are mandatory viewing for players serious about competitive — you see how a top IGL thinks during high-pressure scrims and matches.
